businessModel: Free with a few daily AI credits; paid plans from $20/mo for more credits
paidNote: Plans with higher credit limits start at $20/mo
summary: AI-first Chromium browser for macOS and Windows built by a former Perplexity Comet engineer. Assign tasks from open tabs, schedule workflows and use templates for sales, recruiting and research. SOC 2 Type II claimed.
bestFor: Knowledge workers automating repetitive web tasks
People who keep another browser for daily use
notFor: People wanting a primary privacy browser

pros.title: Scheduled workflows
pros.detail: Save prompts and run them hourly, daily, weekly or custom.

pros.title: Watch and take over
pros.detail: You can watch the agent work and take over; guardrails limit risky actions.

pros.title: SOC 2 Type II
pros.detail: Vendor lists a SOC 2 Type II certification with a trust center.

pros.title: Templates
pros.detail: Pre-built research, sales, recruiting, data and marketing templates.

pros.title: Free to start
pros.detail: Free tier with daily credits; paid from $20/mo.

cons.title: Brand new
cons.detail: Launched Jul 29, 2026; little long-term track record.

cons.title: Self-reported benchmarks
cons.detail: The OdysseysBU chart scoring 98.0 is the vendor's own.

cons.title: Desktop only
cons.detail: macOS and Windows; extensions and privacy details not documented.

faq.a: Yes with limited daily AI credits; paid plans start at $20/mo.
Kevin Jiang (some outlets say Kevin Zhang), ex-Perplexity Comet engineer, with co-founders Vishaal Ram and Howard Zhong.
The founder says most users keep another browser for daily use and open Polar for automation.

timeline.event: Launch and $5.7M seed round led by Madrona announced (Jul 29)
TechCrunch, Digital Trends and others cover launch
Site lists macOS download and Windows availability, SOC 2 Type II

jsSpeed: Blink/V8 engine, Chrome-class JS speed; no vendor benchmark
pageLoad: Chromium rendering; AI sidebar adds overhead
networkSpeed: Chromium network stack with HTTP/3 and preloading
startup: Chromium cold start, heavier than plain Chrome
memory: Chromium multi-process plus AI layer; RAM-heavy
cpu: Chromium-class; agent tasks add background load
lowEnd: Needs modern hardware; AI features add load
installSize: Full Chromium bundle, a few hundred MB
privacyDefaults: Cloud agent; privacy policy not reviewed
blocking: Only MV3 blockers such as uBO Lite are available
securityHardening: Chromium sandbox plus SOC 2 Type II claim
patchSpeed: Follows Chromium stable; lag not independently measured
telemetry: Vendor telemetry; prompts processed in cloud
behaviourCustom: Few shortcut or per-site options documented
tabManagement: Tab groups and search; no workspaces documented
searchFreedom: Default search changeable; AI prompt flow is the focus
translation: AI-driven page translation; no dedicated engine
extras: AI agent and memory; no VPN or wallet
passwords: Basic built-in manager or Chromium defaults
accessibility: Chromium accessibility stack, unverified for AI layer

featureNotes.adBlocker: Only MV3 blockers such as uBO Lite
featureNotes.mv2Support: MV2 removed upstream; Chrome Web Store dropped MV2 Aug 31, 2026
